scientific_integrity: Unrestricted theorem follows from exact finite-state vector identity plus a fixed-transition induction; independently coded graph enumeration tests orders at most 15 and does not by itself prove the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Counts inclusion-minimal sets on labelled paths, without cardinality refinement; historical priority remains open to earlier exact enumeration under alternative terminology.
title: Exact rational census of inclusion-minimal super domination on paths
